title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Accurate test resolution for duplicate test names
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.23.1 fixes a test explorer bug that could target the wrong test when files share the same fully qualified name.

highlights.title: Duplicate Test Name Fix
highlights.description: Tests with the same fully qualified name in different files now resolve to their own file instead of potentially running or debugging the wrong test.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Fixed test run and debug targeting from the gutter and CodeLens: tests sharing the same fully qualified name across different files now each resolve to their own test instead of risking a mismatch.
